title: fix: generate endpoint agent request body in API docs
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a curated request body for postAccountMyModelsEndpointAgents.
- Fixes the generated POST curl example so it includes a JSON payload.
- Unblocks API documentation validation after gen deployments.
- Verifies formatting, live-schema generation, and static APIDOCS validation.

gist.headline: The curl gets its pollen
gist.blurb: The agent endpoint's curl example was arriving empty-handed. It now carries the JSON payload it needs, so the docs grow a working example instead of a decorative shell.
gist.summary: Added a curated request body for `postAccountMyModelsEndpointAgents`, so generated API docs now include a JSON payload in the POST curl example and pass validation after gen deployments.
gist.impact: Developers can copy the agent endpoint's curl example with a usable JSON request body instead of having to infer the required payload themselves.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a tiny API gardener, placing a neatly labeled JSON packet into an otherwise empty curl-shaped delivery tube beside a retro terminal. A small code-plant blooms from the completed request, making the documentation fix visible as a working, well-fed example.
